C-2 archive (debloat Arc 48 / design-arc-48 §3.4): the empirical provenance anchor for MAJOR_PLINY.md §5.4 (Per-worktree virtualenv reflex, Python projects) is the cross-repo ticket ariadne--b93, which does NOT resolve in the-stoa bw (it lives in ariadne-core-workspace). To keep §5.4's provenance recoverable from this repo's bw after the §5.4 body relocates to substrate/modules/per-worktree-venv.md, the verbose provenance is archived here.

== Original empirical anchor (ariadne-core-workspace) ==
ariadne--b93 (filed 2026-05-08 by PLINY in ariadne-core-workspace during the ariadne--rld arc-close as a sideband observation forwarded to POLYBIUS).

== The §5.4 discipline being relocated (full prose, for losslessness) ==
Per-worktree virtualenv reflex (Python projects): When a project uses 'pip install -e' editable installs (Python projects), two parallel worktrees of the same source tree share the virtualenv state — and the 'pip install -e' source path resolves to whichever worktree was installed last. Two parallel worktrees can produce import-from-the-other-worktree behavior under test, where code under test imports from the inactive worktree's source tree rather than the active one.

Reflex: when PLINY creates a fresh worktree for a build dispatch in a Python 'pip install -e'-shaped project, also create + activate a .venv per-worktree (not shared with the source repo's main .venv). One-time ~30s cost per fresh worktree; eliminates the cross-worktree mutation entirely.

Detection: project uses 'pip install -e .[dev]' (or similar editable-install pattern); or PRINCIPAL flags it; or surface the question in the activation phase if uncertain. The reflex is project-class-specific — does not apply to non-Python projects, and does not apply to Python projects that don't use editable installs.

This lives alongside the historical .git/config promote-and-drop reflex, now demoted (see operating-disciplines.md §9 status update). Together the two reflexes express a general pattern: on fresh worktree, apply project-class-specific setup steps before dispatching. The per-worktree .venv is the Python-project member of that family.

Out of scope: non-Python projects; non-'pip install -e' Python projects; wrapper-script automation for the .venv creation (the discipline ships; tooling does not).

== Provenance / why C-2 not C-1 ==
§5.4 has NO stoa-- co-anchor to fold the cross-repo id into (unlike §5.2/§5.3 which mirror to stoa--bxx/stoa--dyb). A bare 'Anchor: ariadne--b93' would be unrecoverable from the-stoa bw. Archiving here makes the provenance recoverable from this repo's own bw. Recover via: bw show <this-ticket-id>.
